campus_notes: Every hall page on liveon.psu.edu publishes a 'Room & Furnishing Dimensions' table (room L×W×ceiling by room type plus furniture, door, and window sizes), with the disclaimer that measurements are approximate and rooms vary. Mattresses are Twin XL (80"). Most halls list height-adjustable beds and movable furniture. Door and window sizes are published for many halls but positions are not.
